items.title: UK insurers' solvency held firm in PRA live stress test but relied heavily on reinsurance and group support
items.summary: The Prudential Regulation Authority's first real-time crisis drill showed all 25 participating general insurers maintained their solvency requirements, though combined shocks would have breached internal risk-appetite limits without external rescue actions.

items.title: MSIG UK appoints Steve Jules as chief financial officer
items.summary: Steve Jules succeeds Andrew Slater as chief financial officer at MSIG UK, subject to regulatory approvals.

items.title: TPR-convened working group launches practical AI guide for pension trustees
items.summary: A working group convened by The Pensions Regulator has published an online resource to help pension professionals navigate artificial intelligence.

items.title: Quilter Cheviot appoints Mark O’Connor as head of international
items.summary: Quilter Cheviot has appointed Mark O’Connor as head of Quilter Cheviot International to support the wealth manager's next phase of growth.

items.title: Marine cargo endorsements and surety bonds put claims triggers under review
items.summary: A new model endorsement clarifies cyber exclusions in marine cargo theft, while legislative moves and war risk policies highlight claims mechanics.

items.title: CIA breach exposes unclassified open-source intelligence network
items.summary: US intelligence agencies have reported a cybersecurity breach affecting an unclassified network used for open-source intelligence analysis.
